dismissed.title: Restoring a stored sort on first load renders and fetches the catalog twice

The stored sort is restored correctly (TC-BUG-40-09), and the brief default order before the restore existed before this change, when catalog-sort.js reordered the cards in place after load. The outcome is right, so this is no correctness defect or regression.
